name: HZ_GEOGRAPHIES
description: The HZ_GEOGRPHIES table stores data representing physical geographies. For example, this table would be used to store United States as a geography with GEOGRAPHY_CODE as US and GEOGRAPHY_TYPE as COUNTRY

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a geography.

columns.name: IMPORT_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Import batch ID of the geography record. This column indicates the batch ID of the latest import batch which created or updated this geography record.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_TYPE
columns.description: Type of geography. Type from HZ_GEOGRAPHY_TYPES_B (Foreign key to HZ_GEOGRAPHY_TYPES_B.GEOGRAPHY_TYPE).

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_NAME
columns.description: Primary Name of the geography.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_USE
columns.description: Usage of geography data. Value is from lookup type ORA_HZ_GEO_USAGE. Sample values are MASTER_REF, ORA_COMPENSATION, SHIPPING, TM, etc.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_CODE
columns.description: User identifier for this geography.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date from which this geography is valid for use.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which this geography is no longer valid.

columns.name: MULTIPLE_PARENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this geography has multiple parents.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.description: Created by module

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Code of the Country to which the Geography belongs. Value is validated against FND_TERRITORIES_VL.

columns.name: GEOCODE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if Geocoding is enabled for a country. Y for enabled, N for disabled.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_NUMBER
columns.description: Geography Number for zone records

columns.name: HIDDEN_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if geography is hidden under grouping Zone in the Territory UI. Y for hidden, null for default behaviour.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: DEFAULT_GEO_PROVIDER
columns.description: Default geography data provider associated with the geographies loaded for the country. Possible values are defined in the 'HZ_GEO_DATA_PROVIDER'  lookup type. For example, LOQATE/NAVTEQ etc.

columns.name: DEFAULT_GEO_VERSION
columns.description: Version number associated with the geographies loaded for the country.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
